Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Wardrobe continuity: mantle-short-cape in plum-gray; a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems.
